messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm awesome at giving
lots of love and attention
to pretty flowers!
{07 0a 00}That's 'cause I am a
pretty flower,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma olen vägev selles, et
anda ilusatele lilledele
palju armastust ja hoolt!
{07 0a 00}Sest ma olen ise
ilus lill,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You should come talk to me
if you want to know all
about watering stuff.
{07 16 00}I just like watering stuff.
That doesn't make me
weird, does it?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sa peaksid minuga rääkima,
kui tahad kõike teada
kastmise kohta.
{07 16 00}Mulle lihtsalt meeldib kasta.
See ei tee minust veel
veidrikku, ega?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}It's kinda neat that
plants can survive just 
on water!
Can you even imagine trying
to live on just water,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}I mean, {01 00 00 05 00}is a life without
caramel yumlumps even
worth living?!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}On päris vahva, et
taimed saavad elada
ainult veest!
Kas sa suudad ette
kujutada elada ainult veest,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}No et, {01 00 00 05 00}kas elu ilma
karamellinämmideta on
üldse elamist väärt?!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}When I'm watering flowers,
I can tell what they're
thinking.
{07 15 00}It took me, like, a million
years to learn Flowerese,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui ma lilli kastan,
saan aru, mida nad
mõtlevad.
{07 15 00}Mul kulus, nagu, miljon
aastat lillekeele õppimiseks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 13 00}Ahhhhhhhh! {01 00 00 05 00}That smells SOOO
heavenly, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 15 00}Huh?{01 00 00 05 00} I'm talking about this
flower! {07 03 00}Did you think I
was talking about you?
messages.et:
{07 13 00}Ahhhhh! {01 00 00 05 00}See lõhnab NII
taevalikult, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 15 00}Mis?{01 00 00 05 00} Ma räägin sellest
lillest! {07 03 00}Kas sa arvasid, et
ma räägin sinust?

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Hey, what are you looking
at?! Yeah, I'm watering
flowers. {01 00 00 05 00}So what?!
{01 00 00 05 00}Maybe I'm in love with them!
Did you even think of that,{01 00 00 05 00}
jerk? {01 00 00 0a 00}I mean, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Hei, mida sa vahid?!
Jah, ma kastan
lilli. {01 00 00 05 00}Mis siis?!
{01 00 00 05 00}Ehk ma olen neisse armunud!
Kas sa mõtlesid sellele,{01 00 00 05 00}
tolvan? {01 00 00 0a 00}Tähendab, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}You know,{01 00 00 05 00} I do WAY more for
my flowers than just pour
water on 'em, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}For one thing,{01 00 00 05 00} I fertilize
them with manure.

{01 00 00 05 00}{07 06 00}Ewwwww! {01 00 00 05 00}It takes some
serious love to be willing
to shovel that stuff!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tead,{01 00 00 05 00} ma teen oma lillede
heaks PALJU rohkem kui
lihtsalt kastan, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Esiteks{01 00 00 05 00} väetan ma neid
sõnnikuga.

{01 00 00 05 00}{07 06 00}Öööök! {01 00 00 05 00}Selleks, et seda
kraami kühveldada, on vaja
tõsist armastust!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm just standing here,
beaming cheerful thoughts
to my cute little flowers.
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Someday, they're going
to talk back to me and
make me super famous!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma lihtsalt seisan siin ja
saadan rõõmsaid mõtteid
oma nunnudele lilledele.
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Kunagi hakkavad nad
mulle vastama ja teevad
mind ülikuulsaks!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}If you're so bored, {01 00 00 05 00}you
should water my flowers for
me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kui sul nii igav on, {01 00 00 05 00}siis
kasta minu eest mu lilli,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I didn't know too much
watering kills flowers!!!{01 00 00 05 00}
Why didn't anyone tell me?!
Don't you understand?! {01 00 00 05 00}I'm a
flower MURDERER! {01 00 00 05 00}They'll put
me in flower PRISON!
{07 08 00}But I'm too young and cute
to get thrown in flower
prison{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma ei teadnud, et liigne
kastmine tapab lilli!!!{01 00 00 05 00}
Miks keegi ei öelnud?!
Kas sa ei saa aru?! {01 00 00 05 00}Ma olen
lille MÕRVAR! {01 00 00 05 00}Mind pannakse
lille VANGLASSE!
{07 08 00}Aga ma olen liiga noor ja
nunnu, et lillevanglasse
sattuda{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Do you like flowers?
{02 00 00 10 10}
Who doesn't?
Meh.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Kas sulle meeldivad lilled?
{02 00 00 10 10}
Kellele ei meeldi?
Nojah.

messages.en:
{07 06 00}You think I don't look like
the flower-watering type?{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}Dude, that is so RUDE!
{07 15 00}I'm way more devoted to my
flowers than you can even
understand, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Sinu arust ma ei näe välja
nagu lillekastja tüüp?{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}Semu, see on nii
EBAVIISAKAS! {07 15 00}Ma olen oma
lilledele pühendunum, kui sa
sa mõista suudad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}A beautiful maiden named
{04 01 00} gracefully
waters her flowers{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 13 00}And along comes a super-
cute prince to sweep her
off her pretty feet.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}Well, that was what I
wanted. {01 00 00 05 00}But then YOU had
to show up, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ilus neiu nimega
{04 01 00} kastab
graatsiliselt oma lilli{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 13 00}Ja siis tuleb ülinunnu
prints ja tõstab ta
ilusatelt jalgadelt üles{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}Noh, seda ma tahtsin.
{01 00 00 05 00}Aga siis pidid SINA
välja ilmuma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
